name: Beat the Beast: Cerberus' Inferno
review:
Beat the Beast: Cerberus' Inferno is a 9-line underworld slot with stacked wilds. The free spins bonus switches to 243 ways with retriggers.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 6,666x cap and a 96.15% RTP. Part of the Beat the Beast series, which pits you against mythical monsters.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
